target: LOI (%) given the paper's own neat-foam control LOI (supplementary task; NOT the Sun & Fu task, never compared to 0.84, never a number of record)
declared: by Opus 5.5, see git commit time; before any run
rows: benchmark 460 rows; papers with >= 1 control row (total_fr_wtpct == 0): 67 papers; scored rows = the 313 non-control rows of those papers
control_LOI: per row: mean LOI of control rows in the same paper with the identical polyol string; if none, mean of all control rows in the paper
target_transform: delta = LOI - control_LOI; prediction LOI_hat = control_LOI + delta_hat
features: round-6 c3 (proxy-free exp092 minus std_*), computed exactly as train_loi_round6.py

candidates.desc: RF (exp092 params) on c3 features -> delta
reference: c3 RF predicting absolute LOI, trained/scored on the same 313 rows and splits (no control info)

protocols: B: GroupKFold by paper 5x10 on the 313 rows (training folds contain only training papers' rows), repeat-0 paper-bootstrap CI; metrics: R2 of absolute LOI and R2 of delta
report: best of d1/d2 by B mean (absolute-LOI R2) goes to numbers_of_record loi.delta_from_control as supplementary after a critic, with d0 and ref beside it
exit_triggers: none apply (not a competitor task); any absolute R2 CI lo > 0.84 is still reported to Arnav before any wording
